snippet.title: Birdwatching Notebook - The First Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Build cozy birdwatching spots on balconies, docks, cliffs, rainforests, or deserts, and wait for lovely birds to visit. A gentle desktop idle game—like tiny postcards on your screen, where beautiful scenes and cute birds accompany your quiet moments.
Steam Storepage : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4111370/Birdwatching_Notebook/
Discord: https://discord.gg/7buEQTsry
